No fabricated event found: 146 spot checks across 38 dossiers (35 pages opened) matched its page; two confidence-3 events had years the page does not state (wu-geng /ledger/1, xing /ledger/1) and one had a region the page does not name (xia-dynasty /ledger/2): all three lowered to 2 by the reviewer and re-validated.

The author put vassalage only on the suzerain side (zeng 632 under Chu, east-zhou 307 under Qin, yelang 183-111 under Nanyue, yiqu 327 under Qin). That follows the schema ('counterpart is the vassal itself in both events'), so it is not a fault in these dossiers, but the reviewer brief's mirror rule reads as if both sides carry it; the suzerain dossiers (chu, qin: ea-01-b/ea-01-a) lack all of them.

Pre-403 Zhao and Wei: xianyu (407, wei) and dai-baidi (457, zhao) name counterparts whose dossiers start in -403; the qin dossier does the same (409, wei). Needs an orchestrator convention (jin as counterpart before 403, or earlier starts for zhao/wei).

Most border reconciliation lies in sibling dossiers already reviewed or written by ea-01-a/b/d: qi has no 700-560 events at all (Tan, Ji, Sui, Lai), jin's 676 catch-all should be 655 for Western Guo and Yu, eastern-zhou's split should be 367, zheng's Hui/Hu/Eastern Guo discs and chu's Huang/Xi/Jiang/Pi/Ju discs disagree with the located discs here.
